instructions:
NEVER run git stash, git checkout, git reset, git restore, git clean, git merge, git rebase or any command that changes the index, the stash stack, or other worktrees' state. Do NOT write to /tmp. FACTS (verified): The Agent SDK is at /Users/matt/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.1/lib/node_modules/@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk (import with an absolute file URL of its sdk.mjs; types in sdk.d.ts: `query({prompt: string | AsyncIterable<SDKUserMessage>, options})` returns a Query (an AsyncGenerator<SDKMessage>) with `interrupt()`, `close()`, `streamInput()`). SDKUserMessage shape: `{type:'user', message:{role:'user', content:[{type:'text', text}]}, parent_tool_use_id:null, session_id}`. Auth works from the user's claude.ai login (no API key). Use model alias 'haiku', cwd = the packet directory, and `includePartialMessages:true`.
An earlier driver (`claude-sdk-driver.mjs` in the packet dir; read it for the working import/option style, especially its `interrupt` mode) showed: after `await q.interrupt()` the turn ended with a `result` message (subtype error_during_execution, terminal_reason aborted_streaming), and THEN the for-await loop threw `Error: Claude Code process exited with code 1`. That driver CLOSED its input stream right after `result`, so it is unknown whether the process dies because of interrupt() itself or because input was closed.
